title: La Voz: la canción grabada de Marta
description: docs/quests/marta.md § Final boss. La Voz sings Marta's own recording in a loop (public/music/marta-voz.m4a): her status ring is the turn of the phrase she is on, in its real rhythm, lit on a note and dark in a silence. Fight tester: Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.song = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.song;

steps.caption: Her first note, Do: the ring is the first turn of her phrase, eight notes in the rhythm she sang them, lit while one sounds
A silence between two of her notes: the ring goes dark and nothing lands on her
Si♭, the second half of her phrase
About 40 s in, the fourth time round: short notes with silences between, a Crescendo for each turn so far
About a minute in: the fast turns, notes bound one into the next
